name: Coyote Block 2 interceptor
description: Rocket-boosted turbojet kinetic interceptor with a tungsten fragmentation warhead, fired from a 4-pack palletized launcher. The RF seeker belongs to Block 1B, not Block 2. Reach is reported at about 15 km.

maxRangeM.condition: interception range 10 to 15 km; the lower bound is 10000 m

flyoutSpeedMps.condition: about 555 to 595 km/h; the lower bound is 154 m/s

seekerAcquisitionRangeM.note: The Block 2 seeker type and its acquisition range are not published; the RF seeker described in open sources belongs to Block 1B. Not established by the public record.

lethalRadiusM.note: Class median of the one sourced interceptor warhead radius: the APKWS M151 burst radius of 10 m (lib-eagls). The Coyote tungsten fragmentation warhead is reported at about 1.8 kg against the 3.95 kg M151, so 10 m sits at the generous end for this round. Raytheon publishes no lethal radius. A one-member median is thin; it is recorded as such so a later source replaces it cleanly.

guidanceNoiseM.note: Planning factor: 2 m 1 sigma terminal guidance noise for a proximity-fuzed interceptor. The one sourced member of the class, the semi-active laser APKWS at better than 1 m CEP, sits at the accurate end; this seeker's accuracy is not published.

maxFlyoutSpeedMps.condition: upper bound of the reported 555 to 595 km/h band (595 km/h = 165 m/s); flyoutSpeedMps keeps the 555 km/h lower bound as the average

boostTimeS.note: Coyote launches on a rocket booster and then cruises on a turbojet, but no booster burn time and no acceleration profile are published.
